response.overview: When Cherry takes a job as a makeup artist on a porn set, her life changes forever. After getting her first taste of the adult industry, Cherry knows that she belongs in front of the camera. She finds herself drawn to working stiff Charles, and after masturbating to his footage later that night, Cherry soon takes the plunge. Alongside her best friend Anya, she dives headfirst into the business, traveling across Europe and becoming one of its hottest stars while discovering just how addictive sex, fame, and attention can be.
response.tagline: Her life. Her rules. Her story.
response.title: Cherry on Top
